name: 01944 · Manchester, MA
findings: ZIP 01944 (Manchester) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01944 (Manchester) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
